findings.issue: Customer sync drops signer_name, signer_identity_number, method, ip_address and user_agent.
findings.impact: Previous code lost required evidence; complete original evidence is now preserved. A separately authorized real Website application and delivery were verified.
findings.remediation: Preserve trusted original signing evidence with stable acceptance time/IP across retries; do not trust browser-supplied IP or BankID metadata.
findings.original_proof: Direct local call of syncPowerOfAttorney with all five fields returns none of them.
findings.current_verification: Behavioral regression coverage; see current report and test evidence.

findings.impact: Outgoing sync payload can claim explicit acceptance absent from its input. This does not prove a successful external signature or delivery.
findings.remediation: Require explicit acceptance and return a field-level validation error for incomplete evidence.
findings.original_proof: Remove accepted from an otherwise normalizable synthetic input: actual normalizer returns accepted:true.
findings.current_verification: Behavioral regression coverage; see current report and test evidence.

findings.issue: Direct JSON reading omits the shared application byte limit, read deadline, MIME and origin checks.
findings.impact: Application-level hardening coverage is incomplete; no CSRF exploit or bypass of platform request limits is claimed.
findings.remediation: Use the common bounded reader while preserving authentication and original operation keys.
findings.original_proof: Source inspection: direct req.json/request.json; no equivalent global proxy controls.
findings.current_verification: Behavioral regression coverage; see current report and test evidence.

findings.issue: Two published specifications changed descriptive signing/IP text under the same version.
findings.original_proof: Initial live drift check failed; manifest-verified sync and subsequent exact live check pass.
findings.current_verification: Behavioral regression coverage; see current report and test evidence.

findings.issue: Durable retries shortened OPS Retry-After to local exponential backoff.
findings.original_proof: Actual worker scheduled a two-hour OPS wait after two minutes, for both root and nested retry guidance.
findings.current_verification: Six actual-worker behavior tests: root/nested long hold, invalid/missing guidance, shorter guidance, permanent error and unschedulable hold.

findings.issue: Replaying an identical canonical quote failed with a pricing snapshot unique-key error; idempotent renewal could silently ignore conflicting content.
findings.proof: Live preview returned 200 then503 for the same quote_attempt_id. Runtime log confirmed duplicate pricing_snapshot_reference.
findings.fix: On duplicate, read and verify original quote, offer, customer type, calculation hash and totals, preserve first audit row; reject conflicts or unavailable original.
findings.verification: 18 actual persistence behavior tests; final live preview retest recorded separately.

findings.issue: A cached canonical OPS address resolution failed a duplicate audit comparison when PostgreSQL normalized its timestamp or transport request/correlation IDs changed.
findings.fix: Compare canonical identity, address, area and assurance, normalize equivalent instants/numbers, preserve the first raw-response hash and audit time; reject business/evidence collisions.
findings.verification: 13 actual persistence behavior tests; final live preview retest recorded separately.
